Maintenance Engineer Space Technology 
 Sassenheim, The Netherlands 
 Your (space) mission 
 As the Maintenance Engineer Space Technology at cosine, you ensure the reliability of the advanced equipment that enables the development and production of cutting-edge space instrumentation. You maintain a unique combination of cleanroom systems, precision manufacturing equipment, and highly specialized laboratory machinery that cannot simply be replaced off the shelf. 
 Tasks & responsibilities 
 In this role you will: - Execute, optimize, and continuously improve preventive maintenance plans for cleanroom systems, laboratory equipment, and precision manufacturing machinery - Diagnose technical failures, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions to minimize downtime and maximize equipment reliability - Maintain and improve critical equipment that supports the development and production of advanced space instrumentation - Manage spare parts, maintenance materials, external suppliers, and maintenance records to ensure operational continuity - Ensure all maintenance activities comply with applicable safety standards and contribute to a safe and reliable working environment 
 Your profile 
 We are looking for candidates with the following qualifications: - MBO+ or HBO degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, or a related technical discipline - Experience maintaining technical equipment in a production, laboratory, or other high-tech environment - Experience working with maintenance or asset management systems - VCA-VOL certification or an equivalent safety qualification - Certified for electrical work, or willing to obtain the required certification - Fluent in both Dutch and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and operational teams
